disposition_reason: Rat absorption and excretion study of alginate as a strontium countermeasure; plasma pharmacokinetic values, no food occurrence.

study.design: in vitro binding and rat feeding experiment
lod: Detection limit for filtrate recovery 1.0 x 10^-4 percent of amount added (Fig. 1 legend)
study.qa: Experiments in duplicate (in vitro); n = 5 per group in vivo

material.label_as_printed: Rat plasma, native strontium, six-week-old rats

regulatory_or_exposure: The authors state that the IAEA recommends sodium alginate at 4 g per person per day for patients exposed to large amounts of radioactive strontium (Introduction, p. 1).
non_numeric_findings: Calcium alginate lowered both strontium and cesium absorption; sodium alginate lowered only strontium absorption (Abstract).
